Uses 2-3 collective dispatches (RS + AG, possibly with custom patterns) but requires careful block ownership mapping and may need multiple AG rounds to handle the overlapping window logic.

Uses ~16 dispatches (8 intra-node + 8 inter-node) but with smaller per-dispatch payload (224/nodes_count smaller groups), trading total dispatch count for reduced per-op latency and bandwidth.

strategies.name: Fused Pre-computation with Single Weighted AllReduce

Eliminates 7 of the 8 dependent all_reduces (only 1 dispatch) at the cost of additional local compute and a more complex weight tensor construction that must encode the iterative dependency structure.
